units.source_text: 不過，我一直把它視為堅強、嚴厲和可怕的東西，

en.t: Still, I had always regarded it as something strong, stern, and frightening,

units.source_text: 如今聽堀木這麼一說，我差點脫口說出：「所謂的世人，不就是你嗎？」

en.t: but when I heard Horiki say that now, I nearly blurted out, "Isn't this so-called society just you?"

units.source_text: 由於不想惹怒堀木，這句話到了嘴邊又咽了回去。

en.t: Because I did not want to anger Horiki, I swallowed the words just as they reached my lips.

units.source_text: （世人是不會原諒的。）（不是世人，是你不會原諒吧？）

en.t: ("Society will never forgive that.") ("It is not society; you are the one who will not forgive it, aren't you?")

units.source_text: （要是這麼做，世人會讓你吃盡苦頭的。）（不是世人，是你吧？）

en.t: ("If you do that, society will make you suffer terribly.") ("It is not society; it is you, isn't it?")

units.source_text: （你很快就會被世人遺忘的。）（不是世人遺忘我，是被你遺忘才對吧？）

en.t: ("Before long, society will forget you.") ("It is not society forgetting me; it is you forgetting me, isn't it?")

units.source_text: 你要清楚自己有多麼可怕、古怪、惡毒、狡詐、陰險吧！

en.t: You should understand just how frightening, strange, vicious, crafty, and sinister you yourself are!
